title: Elastic headcount bucketizer and price levers matrix - Aug 2027
content:
Sheet: Elastic HC Bucketizer & Price Levers (working sheet)

Tab 1: Scenario summary (rows = scenarios)
Scenario,Region,Start HC,End HC,Hires (net),Hiring pace (FTE/month),Avg fully-loaded comp ($k/yr),Token growth / mo (%),Model mix (high-cost %),Infra $/1M tokens,Price $/1k tokens,Estimated tokens/mo (M),Monthly infra cost ($k),Monthly salary cost ($k),Monthly revenue ($k),Net contribution ($k),Breakeven price uplift (%) ,Notes
Base (S1),Global,420,470,50,5,180,8,18,120,1.2,144,750,144,720,3.3,"Base case: steady product-led growth, targeted ops hiring; assumes 8% token growth/mo and 18% high-cost model usage"
Aggressive growth (S2),Global,420,620,200,20,190,18,28,120,1.6,192,960,3,384,640,24.5,"High demand: heavy sales-led expansion + GTM; more expensive model mix; hiring spike concentrated in sales/solutions and infra"
Defensive (S3),US+EMEA,420,445,25,2.5,175,2,12,120,1.0,120,540,375,120,30,-9.8,"Conservative: tightened hiring, slower token growth, prioritize cost containment and quantization"

Notes on columns/formulas used:
- Monthly infra cost ($k) = (Estimated tokens/mo (M) * Infra $/1M tokens)
- Monthly salary cost ($k) = (Average fully-loaded comp / 12) * End HC
- Monthly revenue ($k) = (Estimated tokens/mo (M) * (Price $/1k tokens) * 1000) / 1000 -> simplified = Estimated tokens * Price (k*price)
- Net contribution ($k) = Monthly revenue - (Monthly infra cost + Monthly salary cost)
- Breakeven price uplift (%) computed vs Base price to reach Net contribution >= 0 in given scenario

Bucket rules (working):
- Core engineering hires prioritized into fixed buckets (runtime 40%, infra 30%, SRE 30%)
- Sales hires split 70% enterprise, 30% mid-market; phased to match Dedicated ramp
- Hiring ramp caps: max 25 hires/month org-wide (proxy constraint), scaling only if OSP capacity confirmed

Assumptions for sensitivity table:
- Tokens and infra scale roughly linear with price shifts in this working model except where noted.
- Salary cost treated fixed-monthly based on End HC in each scenario (no instant attrition savings).
- Infra $/1M tokens baseline $120k; improvements from quantization or batching can lower to $90k in long-term experiments (separate tab).

Tab 4: Regional phasing and runway impact (summary)

US,80,12,0,0,-1.5

Quick sensitivity scenarios to model next steps (worklist)
- Run gridded simulation: price (-20%..+40%) x hires (0..+30% of plan) x model_mix (low/med/high) -> produce probability-weighted cash burn / runway tables.
- Add a separate tab for quantization experiments: infra delta by model family and by sequence length distribution.
- Build an automated import from billing export (monthly token ingestion per customer) to update token growth elasticity coefficients for each cohort.

Immediate asks to exec/board (one-pager bullets):
- Approve temporary hire flex-pool of +40 FTEs for sales/solutions to capture Dedicated pipeline; commit to 6-month trial with KPIs (ARR per hire)
- Approve A/B price test on two mid-market cohorts (10% uplift and 25% uplift) with guardrails (quota, usage thresholds, churn monitoring)
- Grant access to billing export for finance-forecasting team to replace manual token growth proxies

Working questions / open items (notes to self):
- How will Dedicated contract SLAs alter per-route infra cost estimate? (need SRE/infra input)
- Does committed capacity discount change model mix assumptions for top customers? (Solutions/Revenue)
- Can we create a quick dashboard (Looker/Sheets) to monitor realized price elasticity after initial A/B tests?

Change log:
- 2027-08-15: initial draft and bucket definitions (Avery Chen)
- 2027-08-18: added regional phasing and sensitivity rows (Miguel Santos)
- 2027-08-22: updated aggressive hire counts and price uplift scenarios after revenue ops sync (Lina Patel)

End of sheet content.
